stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Scythe, TwoHanded: true.
sheet_from: Data/Item/af.OZT (64x128), from MuMain at c0d74c4. The .bmd names af.tga on all 138 triangles; its alpha cuts 7% away.
sheet_note: af is the Balrog's bill: a silver-white blade veined in magenta, a dark red haft band and black spikes.
cutout_from: Declared, not detected, and declared solid. af.tga's alpha cuts 7% away -- the veins drawn through the blade and a thin line down the haft -- and MU alpha-tests a .tga, but it never shows those as holes: its chrome stream is drawn solid under the body first (ZzzObject.cpp:9682-9688), so the cracks are filled with sliding blue chrome. Cut here, the haft, four units thick with its line cut along it, went see-through from the side (the user, 2026-10-10: 'trunk become kind of transparent from that angle'). Solid instead: the cut texels keep the sheet's own dull red under them, and the chrome pass is added over them (chrome, where 'cut' -- pipeline/chrome_sheets.py reads the alpha all the same).
material_note: Six islands on af, sampled per triangle. Island 0 (50) is the bill's blade, silver-white washed red at (138, 99, 96): steel at 0.45. Island 1 (32) is the haft, dark red-brown (93, 35, 11), 2 and 3 (16 each) the black spikes (90, 21, 0), 4 and 5 (12 each) the butt: plate_steel at 0.5 as the Gorgon Staff's pole, with desaturation 1.0 so the red haft does not go grey. MU scrolls this model's BlendMeshTexCoordV (ZzzObject.cpp:5267) and sets no BlendMesh: the scroll moves the chrome pass under the body (chrome_from), and no glow.
chrome_from: RenderPartObjectEffect's MODEL_BILL_OF_BALROG (ZzzObject.cpp:9682-9688): before the body, the whole model again RENDER_TEXTURE with Chrome01 bound, BodyLight (0.5, 0.5, 1.5), mesh 0 its StreamMesh, so it is drawn unlit with its V sliding by ItemObjectAttribute's -(WorldTime % 2000)*0.0005 (:5267-5268), half a sheet a second. The body drawn after it covers it but where af's alpha is cut: the veins through the blade and the line down the haft run with streaming blue chrome. Here a pass added where the sheet is cut (scrolls_per_second 0.5, the renderer's offset being minus the rate), over what shows through the hole where MU draws it solid. pipeline/chrome_sheets.py.
